ASSAULT.YES: Carry your own flag into the enemy base to score.
ASSAULT.NO: Capture the enemy flag and return it to your own base.

SINGLE_FLAG.OFF: Each team has its own flag.
SINGLE_FLAG.1_MINUTE: One flag on the map at a time, in a team base. Teams alternate offense/defense every minute.
SINGLE_FLAG.2_MINUTES: One flag on the map at a time, in a team base. Teams alternate offense/defense every 2 mins.
SINGLE_FLAG.3_MINUTES: One flag on the map at a time, in a team base. Teams alternate offense/defense every 3 mins.
SINGLE_FLAG.5_MINUTES: One flag on the map at a time, in a team base. Teams alternate offense/defense every 5 mins.
SINGLE_FLAG.10_MINUTES: One flag on the map at a time, in a team base. Teams alternate offense/defense every 10 mins.

FLAG_MUST_RESET.YES: Cannot return the flag manually; it resets after a set time.
FLAG_MUST_RESET.NO: Walk over the flag to return it to base.

SCORE_AT_HOME_TO_SCORE.YES: Your team's flag must be at home to score.
SCORE_AT_HOME_TO_SCORE.NO: Can score even if your flag is held by the enemy.

FORCE_FLAG_RESET.YES: Single flag: teams switch offense/defense only after the timer expires and the flag is idle.
FORCE_FLAG_RESET.NO: Single flag: teams switch offense/defense automatically when the timer expires.

TIME_LIMIT.NONE: No time limit. Ends only when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.10: 10min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.15: 15min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.20: 20min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.25: 25min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.30: 30min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.45: 45min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.

MOVING_HILL.YES: Hill teleports to a random location during the game.
MOVING_HILL.NO: Hill stays in the same spot.

SCORE_TO_WIN.1: First to hold the hill for 60s wins.
SCORE_TO_WIN.2: Hold the hill for 2mins to win.
SCORE_TO_WIN.5: Hold the hill for 5mins to win.
SCORE_TO_WIN.10: Hold the hill for 10min to win.
SCORE_TO_WIN.15: Hold the hill for 15min to win.

TIME_LIMIT.NONE: No time limit. Ends only when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.10: 10min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.15: 15min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.20: 20min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.25: 25min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.30: 30min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.45: 45min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.

DEATH_BONUS.NO: Run at the same speed regardless of deaths.

KILL_IN_ORDER.YES: Score only by killing your designated target; target changes after each kill.

KILL_PENALTY.YES: Each kill makes you run slower.
KILL_PENALTY.NO: Run at the same speed regardless of kills.

TIME_LIMIT.NONE: No time limit. Ends only when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.10: 10min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.15: 15min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.20: 20min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.25: 25min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.30: 30min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.45: 45min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.

TRAIT_WITH_BALL.NONE: No special abilities while carrying the ball.
TRAIT_WITH_BALL.EXTRA_DAMAGE: Extra damage while carrying the ball.
TRAIT_WITH_BALL.DAMAGE_RESISTANT: More damage resistant while carrying the ball.

TRAIT_WITHOUT_BALL.NONE: No special abilities when not carrying the ball.
TRAIT_WITHOUT_BALL.INVISIBLE: Only the ball carrier is visible; all others are invisible.
TRAIT_WITHOUT_BALL.EXTRA_DAMAGE: Non-carriers do extra damage; lost while carrying the ball.
TRAIT_WITHOUT_BALL.DAMAGE_RESISTANT: Non-carriers are more damage resistant than the ball carrier.

SPEED_WITH_BALL.NORMAL: Same speed with or without the ball.
SPEED_WITH_BALL.SLOW: Slower than others while carrying the ball.
SPEED_WITH_BALL.FAST: Faster than others while carrying the ball.

BALL_TYPE.NORMAL: Hold the ball as long as possible; first to hold for the specified time wins.
BALL_TYPE.REVERSE_TAG: First killer becomes IT. Kill IT to become IT. Be IT for the specified time to win. No ball.
BALL_TYPE.JUGGERNAUT: First killer becomes Juggernaut and scores all kills. Kill the Juggernaut to take his place. No ball.

RANDOM_START.YES: Ball always appears in the same spot.

MINUTES_POINTS_TO_WIN.1: Hold the ball/be IT for 1min to win. Juggernaut: 1 kill.
MINUTES_POINTS_TO_WIN.2: Hold the ball/be IT for 2min to win. Juggernaut: 2 kills.
MINUTES_POINTS_TO_WIN.5: Hold the ball/be IT for 5min to win. Juggernaut: 5 kills.
MINUTES_POINTS_TO_WIN.10: Hold the ball/be IT for 10min to win. Juggernaut: 10 kills.
MINUTES_POINTS_TO_WIN.15: Hold the ball/be IT for 15min to win. Juggernaut: 15 kills.

TIME_LIMIT.NONE: No time limit. Ends only when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.10: 10min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.15: 15min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.20: 20min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.25: 25min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.30: 30min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.45: 45min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.

TEAM_SCORING.SUM: Team score = sum of members' scores.

RACE_TYPE.NORMAL: Complete a lap by reaching all flags in order.
RACE_TYPE.ANY_ORDER: Complete a lap by touching all flags in any order.
RACE_TYPE.RALLY: One destination point; first player to reach it scores a lap.

TIME_LIMIT.NONE: No time limit. Ends only when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.10: 10min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.15: 15min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.20: 20min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.25: 25min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.30: 30min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.
TIME_LIMIT.45: 45min limit. Ends at limit or when someone wins.

NUMBER_OF_LIVES.INFINITE: Respawn indefinitely until the game ends or time limit is reached.

MAXIMUM_HEALTH.50%: Start with half health and half shields.
MAXIMUM_HEALTH.100%: Start with full health and shields.
MAXIMUM_HEALTH.150%: Start with 50% more health and shield strength.
MAXIMUM_HEALTH.200%: Start with 2x health and shield strength.
MAXIMUM_HEALTH.300%: Start with 3x health and shield strength.
MAXIMUM_HEALTH.400%: Start with 4x health and shield strength.

RESPAWN_TIME_GROWTH.NONE: Respawn time stays at its initial setting.
RESPAWN_TIME_GROWTH.5_SECONDS: Each death adds 5s to respawn; each kill subtracts 5s.
RESPAWN_TIME_GROWTH.10_SECONDS: Each death adds 10s to respawn; each kill subtracts 10s.
RESPAWN_TIME_GROWTH.15_SECONDS: Each death adds 15s to respawn; each kill subtracts 15s.

ODD_MAN_OUT.YES: Odd Man Out cannot respawn until another player dies and becomes Odd Man Out.
ODD_MAN_OUT.NO: Respawn immediately; no waiting for another death.

INVISIBLE_PLAYERS.NO: Players are visible unless using Active Camouflage.

WEAPON_SET.RIFLES: All weapons replaced by assault rifles and plasma rifles.
WEAPON_SET.PLASMA_WEAPONS: All weapons replaced by plasma weapons.
WEAPON_SET.SNIPERS: All weapons replaced by scoped sniper weapons.
WEAPON_SET.ROCKET_LAUNCHERS: All weapons replaced by rocket launchers.
WEAPON_SET.SHORT_RANGE: All weapons are only effective at short range.
WEAPON_SET.CLASSIC: No flamethrower or fuel rod gun.
WEAPON_SET.HEAVY_WEAPONS: Only the most devastating and dangerous weapons.

STARTING_EQUIPMENT.GENERIC: Generic starting weapons on all maps.
STARTING_EQUIPMENT.CUSTOM: Map designer's custom starting weapon set.

VEHICLE_SET.note: Configure vehicles that spawn on the map for all players.

SIDE.note: Only appears if Team Play is enabled.

OBJECTIVES_INDICATOR.MOTION_TRACKER: Objectives appear in your Motion Tracker.
OBJECTIVES_INDICATOR.NONE: Objectives are not shown in your Motion Tracker or on screen.

OTHER_PLAYERS_ON_RADAR.ALL: All other moving players show on your Motion Tracker.
OTHER_PLAYERS_ON_RADAR.FRIENDS: Friendly moving players show on your Motion Tracker.
OTHER_PLAYERS_ON_RADAR.NO: Other players never show on your Motion Tracker.

FRIEND_INDICATORS_ON_SCREEN.NO: Teammates are denoted only by armor color.

FRIENDLY_FIRE.ON: Teammates can hurt each other with weapons/explosives.
FRIENDLY_FIRE.SHIELD_ONLY: Friendly fire reduces shields only, not health.
FRIENDLY_FIRE.EXPLOSIVES_ONLY: Only teammate explosives can hurt teammates.

FRIENDLY_FIRE_PENALTY.NONE: No respawn penalty for team kill.
FRIENDLY_FIRE_PENALTY.5_SECONDS: Team kill adds 5s to your next respawn.
FRIENDLY_FIRE_PENALTY.10_SECONDS: Team kill adds 10s to your next respawn.
FRIENDLY_FIRE_PENALTY.15_SECONDS: Team kill adds 15s to your next respawn.

AUTO_TEAM_BALANCE.YES: Autobalance on; cannot join a fuller team.
AUTO_TEAM_BALANCE.NO: Autobalance off; players can change teams freely.
